note: The fuzzer passes the raw input bytes as a GBytes to fu_firmware_parse, which dispatches to FuUswidFirmware::parse; the input is the attacker-controlled uSWID file.
The raw input bytes are copied into a buffer for header parsing; the header is 25 bytes (16-byte GUID magic, 1-byte hdrver, 2-byte hdrsz, 4-byte payloadsz, 1-byte flags, 1-byte compression).
The CBOR payload is extracted from the uSWID header; the payloadsz field controls how many bytes are passed to the CBOR parser.
The CBOR payload is decoded into a cbor_item_t tree; the root must be a map for parsing to continue.
